issues.explanation: Entity.php contains a stray second block with no function header, which is a PHP parse error and breaks the whole app.
EntityInvite uses HasFactory without importing the trait, so the class fatals and factory linkage is broken.
EntityInvite casts role to App\Enums\UserRole while the contract requires App\Models\UserRole, and all callers use the Enums namespace.
EntityInviteMail does not implement ShouldQueue and uses build() instead of the required content()->markdown contract.
PendingInvites::accept is declared void but returns a redirect, causing a TypeError, and never sets the tenant session as required.
sendInvite has no manager authorization, so any caller can invite despite the manager-only requirement.
Rate limiting is inverted via availableIn and never enforces 10 per hour with tooManyAttempts, allowing unlimited invites or blocking legitimate ones.
Unique-violation handling only checks MySQL error 1062, so SQLite/Postgres races still produce a 500 instead of an inviteEmail error.
Onboarding and entity-switcher integration is absent and pending-invites blade uses raw strings instead of ui.invites_title, Accept/Decline keys and required box/hr layout.
pt_BR and en translations miss required email strings and en.json contains a valueless line that is invalid JSON; files are also under resources/lang instead of lang.
Email view renders You are invited to :entity as :role without join, contradicting the required You are invited to join :entity as :role string.
openMember and saveRole/removeMember query members() (users) with membership IDs and mishandle roles, so modals select the wrong record and role logic is wrong.
removeMember drops the never-owner and never-last-manager rules required to remain, delegating everything to an unverified deleteMember ability.
Component uses protected $rules instead of the required #[Validate] attributes and validate() validates all fields, so sendInvite fails on empty memberRole and saveRole fails on empty inviteEmail.
Audit event uses Log::info instead of the required Log::channel audit channel used by the original code.
Domain writes create invites and memberships directly in Livewire instead of going through app/Actions classes.
Blade performs a query with $entity->members()->find($selectedMembershipId) instead of keeping reads in the component.
saveRole performs no server-side authorization check for manager rights before mutating roles.
Server-only entity context is no longer #[Locked] and mount performs no authorization, leaving state to be supplied or swapped by the client until render.
Diff adds no Pest/PHPUnit tests, so happy paths, validation failures, unauthorized calls and tamper attempts are all uncovered.
routes/web.php deletes the entire application route table and replaces it with two placeholder routes, far beyond the members-route task.

conventions.evidence: Members.php:56-66 uses $rules not #[Validate]; Members.php:183 Log::info not channel audit; no app/Actions; members.blade.php:675-677 queries in view; no docs/CHANGELOG updates

readability.evidence: Members.php:46-50 missing entity property vs mount assignment; Members.php:237 string vs UserRole::admin comparison; PendingInvites.php:336 void return; unused imports Cache, Validator, Log, Gate; nested modal in members.blade.php:699

requirements.evidence: Entity.php:399-405 parse error; EntityInvite.php:27 missing HasFactory import and App\Enums vs App\Models UserRole; EntityInviteMail:365-390 no ShouldQueue/content(); Members.php:111 no authorize, 119 validate-all bug, 123-128 inverted RateLimiter, 170 MySQL-only 1062; PendingInvites.php:336 void redirect + missing tenant session + duplicate membership; no onboarding/switcher wiring; en.json:553 invalid JSON

scope.evidence: routes/web.php:783-876 deletes welcome, auth, onboarding, switcher, dashboard, settings routes and replaces with placeholder members/dashboard routes; all other edits serve the task

security.evidence: Members.php:111 sendInvite no authorize; Members.php:225 saveRole no authorize; Members.php:217 openMember no authorize; Members.php:266 removeMember drops owner/last-manager guards; Members.php:46-50 selectedMembershipId/entity not #[Locked]

simplicity.evidence: Core invite flow is direct with Eloquent, but adds unused listeners/imports (Cache, Validator), duplicated modal markup, and hand-rolled rate-limit/duplicate checks instead of reusing validators/policies

tests.evidence: change.diff:1-877 contains no tests/ directory additions and no Pest/PHPUnit coverage for invites, mail, authorization, or tamper cases

review.summary: Change implements the invite/members UI shape but cannot merge: Entity.php has a parse error, EntityInvite/Mail break their contracts, authorization and rate-limiting are missing or inverted, onboarding/switcher wiring and translations are incomplete, no tests ship, and routes/web.php deletes the app route table.
